$comment: Runtime dependencies the owner has approved, per package, with the reason. Adding one needs the owner's approval in the PR that adds it (AGENTS.md). Dev dependencies are not listed: they are not installed with the package. One of them, geist, is copied into dist as the font files, under its own licence (dist/fonts/OFL.txt). Every version is exact (scripts/check-deps.mjs fails on a range, a tag, an alias or a URL) except those listed in $ranges, the host app's own React, which a package cannot pin.

packages/react.@base-ui/react: Accessible unstyled primitives under every component (foundations: Primitives).
packages/react.cmdk: Command menu filtering and keyboard selection (MIT, pacocoursey/cmdk). Bailey approved it for the Benji primitives.
packages/react.shiki: CodeBlock syntax highlighting; loaded on demand, one grammar at a time.
packages/react.react-dom: Peer: the host app's React DOM.
